name: storm-deepresearch-skill
description: Governed STORM research harness with tasklets, findings pool, receipt chains, evidence ledgers, validated Markdown/HTML/PDF, and trust-approved release.
author: 陈旭
input_files: User files or URLs, retrieval records, STORM findings, semantic reviews, trust evidence, and human approval records.
output_contract: Workspace run with generation artifacts, tasklets, findings pool, receipt chain, evidence ledgers, Markdown/HTML/full PDF, validation, and allowlisted release.
rollback_boundary: Restore v0.4.0-baseline or archived 0.4.0 package; generated runs and approvals are external.
trust_requirement: Release requires Yao Trust, registry hash match, validation receipt binding, and human approval.
